name: Insurtech funding rounds
description: Every insurtech funding round with a disclosed figure, aggregated from across the trade press and deduplicated into one row per round. A floor on real activity, not a market estimate.
terms: Free to use with attribution to Insurtech Daily and a link to https://insurtechdaily.io/funding/.

fields.company: Company that raised the round, as canonicalised by this site. Blank where the headline named no raiser.
fields.company_url: That company's page here. Blank where no company was attributed.
fields.amount_usd_millions: Amount raised, in millions of US dollars, converted at a fixed reference rate.
fields.amount_reported_millions: The same amount in millions of the currency the outlet printed.
fields.reported_currency: ISO code of the currency the outlet printed.
fields.stage: Round stage, only where a headline states it outright. Blank otherwise.
fields.lead_investor: Lead investor, only where a headline states it outright. Blank otherwise.
fields.announced: Date the round was reported, YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.source: Outlet the figure in this row was taken from.
fields.source_url: The report that figure comes from — check it before citing.
fields.also_reported_by: Other outlets that covered the same round, semicolon-separated.
